name: Serendipitous Encounters and a Curious Consensus
description: You run into two old friends near the Dragonspine International Cross Country Challenge camp. A meeting between them is something you haven't considered until now...

steps.description: Talk to the two people deep in discussion

dialogs.content: That's what I'm saying! We've figured it out.

Eula detests rigid, stuffy people the most! You know, the kind with 'narrow-mindedness' written all over their faces. They always get stuck obsessing over the tiniest details, and all they do is trip people up on every little step!
Maybe they even wear a monocle and can't go anywhere without a book in their hands. But when you take a closer look, you realize they haven't really read it though, and are just using it as a prop...
What they're really trying to do is to put on a so-called intellectual aura, and get a leg up on you before the conversation even starts!
Haha, that was spot on. I can picture it already!
Yanfei and... Amber? Now that's a duo Paimon's never seen before!
Hey! What are you two chatting about?
Oh hey, Honorary Knight and Paimon! You're here!
Yanfei and I were just discussing if we should have a few "Big Bad Snowman" as Easter eggs in our game.
Ooh, like targets that look like monsters?
We were thinking that, apart from the more typical monsters, we could also include some less traditional characters.
Looks like Yanfei and I share too many similar ideas about the casting!
Yanfei, didn't expect to see you here. What a pleasant surprise!
It's kind of amazing. Seeing you side by side, Paimon can tell right away you really click!
#Yeah, I'm really surprised to run into {NICKNAME} and Paimon in Mondstadt too!
You know, this isn't actually my first time in Mondstadt. I've helped with several civil lawsuits here before...
This time, Yaoyao and I had just finished up our work when I happened to hear about the opening of the Dragonspine International Cross Country Challenge, so I thought I'd check it out.
As it turns out, after I reached the venue, I ran into Amber while asking for directions. We hit it off immediately.
So, I decided to come try out the game Amber's managing, and chip in with some suggestions!
Heh, any friend of Eula is my friend too. And fun games are meant to be enjoyed together with other people!
Want to give this a try, Honorary Knight and Paimon? This mini-game is called "Jade Pitching," and it's designed to help our guests from far and wide to unwind and ease their stress.
Yeah! Let's practice our snowball fight skills, it might come in handy in the future!
And if we ever find ourselves bored with little to do, we can play to see who's better. The loser has to cook!
In that case, I can't miss out!
Snowballs, fireballs... You know, all elemental projectiles have something in common.
For someone as skilled in combat as you are, this should be a piece of cake!
I'm pretty good at throwing snowballs.
I've never imagined the two of you would meet up.
Is there someone Eula detests?
